log_level.description: Log verbosity level for OpenCPN. Allowed values: trace, debug, info, message, warning, error.

config_dir.description: Alternative configuration directory for OpenCPN data (e.g., charts, routes).

no_opengl.description: If true, disables OpenGL video acceleration using the --no_opengl flag.

rebuild_gl_cache.description: If true, forces rebuilding the OpenGL raster cache on start using --rebuild_gl_raster_cache.

rebuild_chart_db.description: If true, rescans chart directories and rebuilds the chart database on start using --rebuild_chart_db.

plugin_dirs.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for plugin shared objects (.so).

openvpn_user.description: User account to run the OpenCPN service as. Note: Variable named openvpn_user in schema to avoid naming conflict, but intended for opencpn user.
